text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wondering if I could be of any help to
her
research, I scour the library for

Umamusume-related books.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, seeing as we're in a library, I
suppose
you came with the intent to
read, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What is it that's piqued your interest?
Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This is... to help with my research?
choice_data_list: 研究の手伝いになるかと思って
choice_data_list_en: I thought it might help with your research.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh, hahaha! How diligent of you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, what I require most from you is
a
healthy mind and body suitable for
testing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you want to help, then let's start with
some
basic bodybuilding!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're in luck. I just happen to have
something
I've been dying to test.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If the experiment is a success, no matter
how out
of shape you may be, I can
transform you to be fit
like an athlete!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let us begin! The experiment to obtain
your
ultimate physique!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! I can't wait to see the results,
Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps pleased by my cooperative
attitude,
Agnes Tachyon goes about her
business in higher
spirits than usual.
